Dividend Entitlement and Trading Mechanics STRC Stock has, and effective January 1, 2027, STRF Stock, STRK Stock and STRD Stock will have, a dividend record date on every calendar day, including weekends and market and bank holidays. However, for any shares cleared through The Depository Trust Company ("DTC"), a record date that falls on a weekend or other DTC holiday will be deemed by DTC to fall on the immediately preceding day that is not a DTC holiday. Nasdaq generally sets the ex-dividend date on the record date or, if the record date is not a trading day, the immediately preceding trading day. As a result, if multiple daily dividends have record dates that fall on consecutive days that are DTC holidays, then they will be deemed by DTC to share a single record date occurring on the last preceding day that is not a DTC holiday, and by Nasdaq to share a single ex-dividend date occurring on the last preceding day that is a trading day, and will be paid together on the same payment date. Records Ten Straight Weeks of SOL Treasury Growth; CHAD Extends Daily Dividend Track Record SOL Treasury Reaches 2.62 Million Following Addition of 9,482 SOL and SOL Equivalents CHAD Combines a 14.00% Annual Dividend Rate with 31 Consecutive Business Days of Dividend Payments BOCA RATON, FL — November 16, 2026 — DeFi Development Corp. (Nasdaq: DFDV) (the "Company" or "DeFi Dev Corp."), the first U.S. public company with a treasury strategy built to accumulate and compound Solana ("SOL"), today announced its tenth consecutive week of SOL treasury growth and its 31st consecutive business day of dividend payments on its Variable Rate Series C Perpetual Preferred Stock (Nasdaq: CHAD). The Company added 9,482 SOL and SOL equivalents since its last update, bringing total holdings to approximately 2,619,311, up from 2,609,829. Ten Weeks of SOL Treasury Growth The latest addition extends the Company’s weekly accumulation streak that began September 14, 2026, following its return to active accumulation on August 27. Beyond growing total holdings, the Company’s objective remains increasing SOL per share ("SPS") over time. DeFi Dev Corp. pursues this objective through capital markets activity, staking, validator operations, and other onchain opportunities. These activities combine the acquisition of additional SOL with rewards generated by the Company’s existing treasury and infrastructure. CHAD: 14.00% Annual Dividend Rate, Paid Daily CHAD has now paid dividends for 31 consecutive business days, building a payment track record alongside the Company’s growing SOL treasury. Its current annual dividend rate of 14.00% represents $1.40 per share on an annualized basis, based on its $10 stated amount. The Company’s two publicly traded securities serve different investor objectives: DFDV common stock aims to provide amplified exposure to SOL, while CHAD offers income-oriented investors a preferred security with daily cash distributions when declared. CHAD’s dividend rate is variable. Dividends are cumulative and payable when declared by the Company’s Board of Directors. Learn more about CHAD at www.defidevcorp.com/chad . For more information, visit defidevcorp.com . To stay up to date with the latest developments and insights, subscribe to our blog . About DeFi Development Corp. DeFi Development Corp. (Nasdaq: DFDV) has adopted a treasury policy under which the principal holding in its treasury reserve is allocated to SOL. Through this strategy, the Company provides investors with direct economic exposure to SOL, while also actively participating in the growth of the Solana ecosystem. In addition to holding and staking SOL, DeFi Development Corp. operates its own validator infrastructure, generating staking rewards and fees from delegated stake. The Company is also engaged across decentralized finance (DeFi) opportunities and continues to explore innovative ways to support and benefit from Solana’s expanding application layer. The Company is also an AI-powered online platform that connects the commercial real estate industry by providing value-add services and software subscriptions to multifamily and commercial property professionals, as the Company connects the increasingly complex ecosystem that stakeholders have to manage. The Company’s data and software offerings are generally offered on a subscription basis as software as a service. Increases SOL Treasury to 2.61 Million Company Adds 8,881 SOL and SOL Equivalents, Marking Nine Consecutive Weeks of SOL Purchases CHAD's 14.00% annual dividend rate continues to offer one of the most competitive income opportunities in digital credit BOCA RATON, FL — November 9, 2026 — DeFi Development Corp. (Nasdaq: DFDV) (the "Company" or "DeFi Dev Corp."), the first U.S. public company with a treasury strategy built to accumulate and compound Solana ("SOL"), today announced that its total holdings of SOL and SOL equivalents increased by 8,881 SOL since its last update, bringing its treasury to approximately 2,609,829 SOL, up from 2,600,948 SOL. The increase marks the Company's ninth consecutive week of SOL purchases since September 14, 2026, building on its return to active accumulation on August 27. The continued purchases reflect the Company's continued execution of its treasury strategy, focused on growing SOL holdings and increasing SOL per share ("SPS") over time. "Our strategy remains consistent: accumulate SOL, compound our holdings, and grow SOL per share," said Joseph Onorati, Chief Executive Officer of DeFi Development Corp. "We remain focused on disciplined execution and positioning the Company to create long-term shareholder value as the Solana ecosystem continues to develop." CHAD Continues to Offer One of the Highest Dividend Rates in Digital Credit DeFi Development Corp.'s Variable Rate Series C Perpetual Preferred Stock (Nasdaq: CHAD) continues to offer a 14.00% annualized dividend rate, among the highest in the digital credit market. Based on its $10.00 stated amount, CHAD's 14.00% annualized dividend rate equates to $1.40 per share annually. Dividends are cumulative and payable each business day when, as and if declared by the Company's Board of Directors. CHAD offers income-focused investors a differentiated way to participate in the Company's SOL treasury strategy. Unlike traditional corporate treasuries, which typically hold cash and other low-yielding assets, DeFi Development Corp.'s SOL holdings can generate recurring income through native staking and validator operations. The Company believes this productive treasury provides a strong foundation for scaling its digital credit offerings. "CHAD combines a 14% annualized dividend rate with a treasury of productive SOL assets, creating what we believe is a compelling proposition for income-focused investors," said Onorati. "As we grow CHAD, our objective is to expand our capacity to accumulate SOL while continuing to drive long-term SOL per share growth for common shareholders." The Company intends to continue growing CHAD as a core component of its long-term capital strategy, providing income-focused investors with an alternative to common equity while supporting continued SOL accumulation. Learn more about CHAD at www.defidevcorp.com/chad . For more information, visit defidevcorp.com . To stay up to date with the latest developments and insights, subscribe to our blog . About DeFi Development Corp. DeFi Development Corp. (Nasdaq: DFDV) has adopted a treasury policy under which the principal holding in its treasury reserve is allocated to SOL. Through this strategy, the Company provides investors with direct economic exposure to SOL, while also actively participating in the growth of the Solana ecosystem. In addition to holding and staking SOL, DeFi Development Corp. operates its own validator infrastructure, generating staking rewards and fees from delegated stake. The Company is also engaged across decentralized finance (DeFi) opportunities and continues to explore innovative ways to support and benefit from Solana’s expanding application layer. The Company is also an AI-powered online platform that connects the commercial real estate industry by providing value-add services and software subscriptions to multifamily and commercial property professionals, as the Company connects the increasingly complex ecosystem that stakeholders have to manage. The Company’s data and software offerings are generally offered on a subscription basis as software as a service.
